author: Retro Game Corps
description:
New apps now allow us to install and play Xbox Game Pass games directly on Linux and Android devices. Here's how to set it up.

Xodus Nexus app: https://github.com/domsvoboda/xodus-nexus
Xodus Nexus compatibility list: https://github.com/domsvoboda/xodus-nexus/wiki/Compatibility
DroidDeck (for Android): https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/releases
Xbox Game Pass: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/xbox-game-pass
Xodus (original backend) app: https://github.com/xodus-gaming/xodus
